axisSemantics.description: Unique crossing connectors are grouped by local undirected axis. Axis bins do not imply heading, origin, or destination.

claimBoundary.description: Interior crossings of bounded qualified report-neighbor connectors. Connectors are exploratory associations, not observed craft movement.

temporalSemantics.description: Five-year bands summarize recurrence. The default crossing analysis spans all qualified catalog years; runtime filters may constrain connector dates or their separation.
